title: Canonical vector-purity base-change equation
statement: For an integration-normalized inverse-purity family gamma of [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization], define its arbitrary-base-change compatibility as follows. For every Cartesian presentation of the pulled-back rank-d bundle pi':E'→B' with g:B'→B and g':E'→E, take e:g'^*Rpi^!→Rpi'^!g^* to be the actual exceptional exchange. Form a:g'^*(W tensor pi^*K)≈W' tensor pi'^*g^*K from the actual pullback tensorator, pullback-composition isomorphisms and independently normalized Tate pullback. There is a separately integration-normalized gamma' such that e_K is invertible on K in D^b_ctf and g'^*(gamma_K)≫e_K=a_K≫gamma'_(g^*K). The bundle bases are Noetherian and the annihilator is invertible, as required to form their integration traces.
